'''Jungle Wolves{{sic}}''' are an uncommon type of [[wolf]] found in the [[Kharazi Jungle]]. They only drop [[wolf bones]] and [[raw wolf meat]] when killed. If you get wolves as a [[slayer]] assignment, you can slay these for the task. They are aggressive to all players and will start pursuing from a distance. They are similar to regular wolves, but the main differences are their colour and location.

Their location in the jungle makes them hard to reach; if one plans to hunt Jungle wolves, be aware that many other native animals are poisonous, so be sure to have [[antipoison]]. There are only seven Jungle wolves in the entire Kharazi jungle, so finding them may be difficult.
